WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_id FROM team
),
team_manager_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ts.team_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN mh.g > 0 THEN CAST(mh.w AS FLOAT) / mh.g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(mh.year) as record_count
  FROM team_stats ts
  LEFT JOIN manager_half mh ON ts.team_id = mh.team_id
  GROUP BY ts.team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_win_rate
  FROM team_manager_stats
  WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  tms.team_id,
  tms.avg_win_rate,
  tms.record_count,
  tms.avg_win_rate - om.mean_win_rate as diff_from_mean
FROM team_manager_stats tms, overall_mean om
WHERE tms.avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
